prompt_rules.text: Before an irreversible Amazon order or account mutation, reconcile current mutable state with documented reads: inspect the cart, remove anything not requested, add only the requested products and quantities, and validate inventory, price, delivery, payment, and applicable discount constraints. If an operation sends or requires a one-time code, inspect the indicated email or text-message source, paginate until an empty page, and use only the retrieved code; do not guess or retry unvalidated candidates. After the side effect, verify the resulting order or account state before completion. For read-only work or already-clean state, proceed without unnecessary discovery.

examples: Before an Amazon order, inspect the current cart. If it contains anything not requested, clear it, add only the requested products and quantities, then re-inspect before ordering.
When an operation says it sent a code, inspect the indicated email or text-message source and paginate until an empty page before using the code; never guess or retry an unvalidated candidate.
